opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death, providing temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (most often in the UK) until they can return home. Cara checks applicants' backgrounds, encourages them to identify potential supervisors/host institutions, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding, and helps with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard, either for postgraduate qualifications (e.g. PhD) or postdoctoral research placements.
